fourthwall.shop.description: Reads the Fourthwall shop Cuebot knows (the API connection is on the Webhooks page).
fourthwall.shop.returns: name, address (for gift links), connected, giftingPlatform (who runs stream gift draws), lastCatchUp and lastError.

fourthwall.tiers.description: Lists your Fourthwall membership tiers. Needs the Fourthwall API connected.
fourthwall.tiers.returns: A list of tiers with id, name, monthly (price per month), currency and members (how many Cuebot knows).

fourthwall.members.description: Says how many Fourthwall members Cuebot knows, from webhooks and the API's member list.
fourthwall.members.returns: count, perTier (tier name to count) and lastSync.

fourthwall.products.description: Lists the products the Products widget shows when it is set to your Fourthwall shop.
fourthwall.products.returns: A list of products with name, price (written nicely), amount, currency, image, soldOut and url.

fourthwall.totals.description: Reads your Fourthwall sales over the last hours: purchases (not samples, claimed gifts or cancelled orders) and completed donations. Needs the Fourthwall API connected.
fourthwall.totals.returns: revenue, orders, donations, donationCount and currency; or null when the API call failed.

fourthwall.createPromo.description: Makes a percent-off discount code in your Fourthwall shop, usable once per customer. Needs the Fourthwall API connected.

parameters.code: Optional. The code; leave out for a random one like STREAM7K2QXP.
parameters.maxUses: Optional. How many times it can be used in total (default: no limit).

fourthwall.createPromo.returns: The code, or null when Fourthwall refused it.

fourthwall.catchUp.description: Asks Fourthwall which events it sent and runs those that never reached Cuebot. Needs the Fourthwall API connected.
fourthwall.catchUp.returns: A status line, like "Replayed 2 Fourthwall event(s) that never arrived."
